status: Progress/Skeleton/Meter complete at assigned native/Lit boundaries; M18 Stat/Toast/Feedback remain
implementation: Native progress distinguishes omitted value from real zero; numerical semantics use the current value while decorative motion interpolates
Native meter is present only for known valid measurements; loading/missing data use distinct nonnumeric alternatives
Explicit low/high/optimum bounds determine quality regions; no built-in percentage cut points
Circular sizes and split-arc geometry retain the audited reference; scalar arithmetic handles large finite ranges without overflow
Skeleton retains authored content, hides/inerts it during loading and keeps a real sized wrapper
RepeatingMotion extracts existing Spinner/Status lifetime through public Lit Motion 1.1.0 APIs and serves Progress/Skeleton too
The existing optional-number converter moves to shared attributes and is reused by the formatters and measurement components
Gauge and retired Progress/Skeleton interfaces and producers are removed; foundation examples use explicitly configured Meter data
